# Version and verify source patches to the OH embedding and native plugins

## Platform difference

An embedding/plugin compiled against one OH API generation may need targeted changes for another; patch timing matters when sources are downloaded or generated during the build.

## Implementation

MR adds compatibility replacements for keyboard/window APIs, then moves patch application after native dependencies become available. It later patches WebView API signatures as a second compatibility layer. Pica Comic matches different embedding source layouts and patches both project HARs and installed copies for its viewport workaround. Zhiji moves from direct HAR declarations to flutter-hvigor-plugin source injection for its selected toolchain. FlClash patches its selected Flutter OH tooling to package NativeAssetsManifest.json while moving SQLite packaging to native-asset hooks; adopting hooks still required checking their OH build integration.

## Applicability

These are source-version-specific mechanisms. Modern source injection and older manual HAR wiring should not be mixed without understanding the generated build graph.

These observations apply to the pinned project revisions below, studied on 2026-09-30 and backfilled on 2026-10-06. Unspecified SDK/device compatibility remains unknown; this is not a fresh upstream assessment.

## Pitfalls and limitations

A replacement constant or removed call may reduce semantics while making compilation possible. Patching a downloaded cache without recording the input/replacement is not reproducible. Do not treat a text replacement matching nothing as successful.

## Verification

Record input revisions and patch match counts, apply after dependencies exist, inspect the resulting source, rebuild and test affected keyboard/window/WebView behavior after every SDK change.

Evidence tier: historical source/diff studies, with commit and path existence rechecked in local Git during this backfill. No application build, dependency resolution, signing, installation or device execution was performed. Proposed checks above are acceptance criteria, not completed tests.
